name: Bach Ma
provinceNote: The visitor center is in xã Phú Lộc, thành phố Huế. A July 2025 park note places the expanded park on thành phố Huế and thành phố Đà Nẵng. A February 2012 note still splits that expansion into Thừa Thiên Huế and Quảng Nam.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Come for the cloud forest at the high lookout, where the trail puts the lagoon and the sea in one view. Sleep on the summit if that look is the morning, after the park has accepted a registration made at least one day ahead. Sleep in Cau Hai, at the gate, if the summit night is refused. Hue is the citadel, Lang Co is the bay, and Da Nang is the city. Day visitors are back at the visitor center before 17:00.
timeNeeded: A day from the gate, or a night if the viewpoint is the morning
fee: Check on arrival. Park table, 1 May 2025: adult 65,000 VND, reduced 25,000 VND. VnExpress, updated 4 Feb 2025: adult 60,000 VND, reduced 20,000 VND.
getThere: From Hue, 40 km on the park feature, or 45–55 km in the VnExpress handbook. Minutes are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bach Ma: stay for the high lookout, or sleep at the gate
seoDescription: Sleep on the Bach Ma summit if the lookout is the morning. Day visitors return before 17:00. The road still stops at km 12, and the two ticket tables disagree.
intro: Forest fills the near ground, and the trail at Hải Vọng Đài puts the lagoon and the sea in the same look, mountain wind and sea wind together. The walk is 800 m of granite from biệt thự Morin, the easiest trail on the park page, for any age. Sleep on the summit if that look is a morning, and only after the park has accepted a registration made at least one day ahead. Sleep in thị trấn Cầu Hai, at the gate, if that registration is refused. Hue is the citadel and the Huế bowls. Lang Co is the bay the viewpoint looks at. Da Nang is the city and the beach, over Hải Vân. A same-day citadel plus the walk from km 12 is how both get rushed.

The park is the whole trip: the road, the viewpoint, thác Đỗ Quyên, Ngũ Hồ, and the gate market. Decision 214/CT of 15 Jul 1991 established it at 22,031 ha. Decision 01/QĐ-TTg of 2 Jan 2008 expanded it. The July 2025 park note prints 37,423.1 ha for that decision. The February 2012 note, and the 2021 feature on the park site, print 37,487 ha. VnExpress prints more than 37,400 ha. Vietnam Airlines prints nearly 37,500 ha. The 2021 feature calls this the only primary-forest belt in Vietnam running from the East Sea to the Laos border. The airline guide says the range reaches the Cambodian border. Those are not the same border. ASEAN recognition is October 2022 in the director’s speech as printed, and the certificate was handed over on 3 Dec 2025.

A day ticket has no evening in the park. Be at the visitor center before 09:00 so the park can group the walk, and be back before 17:00 the same day. Vietnam Airlines prints a 07:30 open on a table dated 1 May 2024. That is a different clock. From 1 Jan 2026 the park notice stops motor vehicles at the slip at km 12: walk about 500 m across it, then about 7 km on foot to Hải Vọng Đài. On 13 Jun 2026 the director told Báo Văn hóa the slip was still unrepaired: walk about 600 m on a path around it, then a motorbike or more walking. The May 2025 shuttle table is still on the site and still prices a ride to the summit. Confirm which rule the gate is using that morning.

Read the heights as separate sentences. The park trail pages, updated 1 Jul 2025 and 1 May 2025, say about 1,430 m. The VnExpress handbook says about 1,430 m at the viewpoint and a historical summit of 1,440 m. The 2021 feature says the highest summit above the prayer bell is 1,450 m. A 7 Mar 2025 VnExpress report says Vọng Hải Đài is higher than 1,400 m.
gettingAround: The usual previous stop is Hue, or Da Nang if you are already south of Hải Vân. The night, when there is one, is the summit or thị trấn Cầu Hai. VnExpress names Phú Bài for Hue at about 35 km, and Đà Nẵng airport at about 60 km. Door-to-door minutes are check on arrival. A taxi fare from Phú Bài was printed in one newspaper and is not repeated here.

Hue to the park is 40 km on the park-site feature, about 40 km in the March 2025 flower report, and 40 km on the Vietnam Airlines page. The VnExpress handbook says 45 to 55 km, depending on CT02 or National Highway 1A. Da Nang to chợ Cầu Hai is about 40 km on National Highway 1A over Hải Vân, then about 1 km, on the park-site feature. VnExpress puts Đà Nẵng airport at about 60 km and does not repeat that 40 km city figure. Vietnam Airlines says Đà Nẵng is 70 km south. Lang Co is about 30 km from the center of thị trấn Lăng Cô, on VnExpress only. Drive minutes on each of these are check on arrival.

From chợ Cầu Hai the park-site feature says about 1 km, then left on Trần Đình Túc. VnExpress says some coaches stay on Highway 1A, so you change and ride more than 3 km. The 1 km and the more-than-3 km start in different places. The green round park sign on the right is the turn. The sign for Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Bạch Mã is the other road.

The Vietnam Railways heritage train prints Lăng Cô between Hue and Da Nang and does not print Cầu Hai. Whether a train sets down at the gate is check on arrival. The same page says the Hue–Da Nang ride is about 3 hours and prints two clocks. One block is HĐ1 Hue 7:05, Lăng Cô 8:38, Đà Nẵng 10:10; HĐ3 Hue 14:30, Lăng Cô 16:42, Đà Nẵng 18:15; HĐ2 Đà Nẵng 07:05, Lăng Cô 09:14, Hue 11:03; HĐ4 Đà Nẵng 15:20, Lăng Cô 16:50, Hue 18:15. The other block is Hue–Đà Nẵng morning 07:45–10:35, with Lăng Cô at 09:02 and a departure 09:12, and afternoon 14:25–17:40, with Lăng Cô at 16:12 and a departure 16:22. Northbound morning is Đà Nẵng 07:50, Lăng Cô 09:06, Hue 11:05. Northbound afternoon is Đà Nẵng 15:00, Lăng Cô 16:16, Hue 17:45.

The gate-to-summit road is about 16 km on the park-site feature, a walk of about 4–5 hours if you start before 09:00, or a car of 16 seats or fewer hired at the gate. The May 2025 shuttle table, tax excluded, labels the 16-seat rows: 1,200,000 VND in a day, maximum 12 Vietnamese guests or 8 foreign guests, and 1,500,000 VND overnight. The 7-seat rows print 1,000,000 VND and 1,300,000 VND, maximum 5 Vietnamese guests or 4 foreign guests, and the day and night labels did not load. The 4-seat rows print 900,000 VND and 1,200,000 VND, maximum 3 Vietnamese guests or 2 foreign guests, and those labels did not load either. Cars larger than 16 seats use the park shuttle. That table and the December 2025 notice, which stops motor vehicles at km 12, cannot both be the rule on the same morning. Check on arrival.

The notice prints a landline as 0234 871 330 in office hours. The footer prints 0234.3871330. Mobiles on the notice are 0836 356 669, 0363 272 464, and 0981 174 761. The representative office, not the gate, is 74 Phạm Văn Đồng, phường Vỹ Dạ, thành phố Huế. Office hours are not a gate clock. The park notes do not print a surveyed pin. The map uses the camera position on the photograph of the villa: 16.21004 north, 107.82526 east.

stayAreas.name: The summit
stayAreas.summary: Park villas, if a registration made at least one day ahead was accepted. The pages name Morin, Kim Giao, Đỗ Quyên, and nhà Bảo An. Thông Nàng and Kim Giao, the two permitted camps, sit at km 17. No hotel brand is a pick. A room rate was not on the May 2025 tariff.

stayAreas.name: Cau Hai
stayAreas.summary: Thị trấn Cầu Hai, at the gate, when the summit night is refused. Thanh Niên describes it as the night before the mountain. No hotel brand is a pick.

eat: The morning at the gate is a thick Huế-style coffee in the town, then chợ Cầu Hai, facing the lagoon. Thanh Niên describes brick crab with a thin shell and red roe, land shrimp that Huế cooks as tôm chua with boiled pork and pickled bean sprouts, and the brackish fish cá kình, cá dìa, cá hanh, and cá đối, caught in phá Tam Giang and đầm Cầu Hai. The essay does not print a recipe, a grill, or a stall price. The market clock is check on arrival.

Inside the park, the kitchens the management allows serve phở, bún, or mì bò at breakfast, a set rice, and grill or seafood if you order ahead. That is a canteen list, not a local dish. Kitchen hours and prices are check on arrival. Huế bowls stay in Hue. Lang Co’s beach dishes stay on that bay.
interestsBody: Hải Vọng Đài is the cloud-forest lookout, 800 m from Morin. The park trail pages say about 1,430 m. The handbook adds a historical summit of 1,440 m. The 2021 feature says 1,450 m above the bell. A March 2025 report says higher than 1,400 m.

Đỗ Quyên is off km 16, a headwater of one of the two main branches of the Hương. The park trail page says higher than 300 m, about 1.5 km, nearly 700 steps, and about 30 minutes. The walking page says about 300 m. VnExpress says nearly 400 m and agrees on about 30 minutes and nearly 700 steps. Ngũ Hồ is five pools near biệt thự Kim Giao. The park says about 1.5 km and 30 minutes, and that you can swim in lakes 4 and 5 if you can take the cold. VnExpress says nearly an hour for that leg. Do not budget the viewpoint, the fall, and the pools as one hour.

The French station is the villas in this forest. Who built it is not settled. The pages still agree there were about 139 of them. A night up here needs the day’s registration. The tariff lists a large campfire from 19:30 to 22:00. The dong cell for the fire did not load on the park page. The hour the summit goes quiet after that is check on arrival.

The park sells a bird-calling guide, Trương Cảm, at 700,000 VND on a weekday and 900,000 VND on a holiday. VnExpress says early morning and late afternoon, and a clock for the walk is check on arrival. The Trĩ Sao trail is named for the pheasant. The page describes pools, not a sighting.

interestGroups.title: The summit view
interestGroups.summary: For the morning at Hải Vọng Đài, when forest, the lagoon, and the sea are the point.
body: The paved 800 m from biệt thự Morin is a short walk once you are there. Getting to Morin is the long part. From km 12 the park says about 7 km on foot. The full gate-to-summit walk on the 2021 feature is about 4–5 hours. A bronze bell sits at the viewpoint, and the 2021 feature says the highest summit is above the bell. Day visitors still have to be back at the visitor center before 17:00.

cards.title: The high forest
cards.summary: Forest in the near ground, and white water over the rock, from the high side of the park.

interestGroups.title: The falls and the five lakes
interestGroups.summary: For Đỗ Quyên and the five cold pools. They are two walks, not one hour.
body: The park trail page puts thác Đỗ Quyên higher than 300 m, about 1.5 km and 30 minutes from km 16, and nearly 700 steps down. The walking page says about 300 m. VnExpress says nearly 400 m. Red đỗ quyên flowers on the rocks and the stream in spring. Ngũ Hồ is the chain of five pools near Kim Giao. Lakes 4 and 5 are the swim, if you can take the cold. A zip-line over Đỗ Quyên was surveyed as a road repair and was not built.

cards.title: Do Quyen Waterfall
cards.summary: White water on the cliff, off km 16. The pages do not agree on the height. The walk is about 30 minutes.

interestGroups.title: The granite villas
interestGroups.summary: For a night in the forest villas, after the park has accepted a day’s registration.
body: The pages name Morin, Kim Giao, Đỗ Quyên, and nhà Bảo An. VnExpress, 7 Mar 2025, says Raoul Desmarest, a public-works engineer, in March 1933, after days of walking, and about 139 villas on the mid-slope. The November 2024 handbook says M. Girard in 1932, the resort complete in 1942 from 1,200 m to a 1,440 m summit, with nearly 139 villas. The park-site feature says 139 villas finished in 1942. Vietnam Airlines says Girard in 1932, 139 villas by 1937, a forest reserve in 1937, a South Vietnam protected area in 1962, and a national park in 1991. The 1962 line is that page only. A room rate on the May 2025 tariff was not printed. Check on arrival.

cards.title: Summit villas
cards.summary: A villa in the forest, for the night that makes the viewpoint a morning. The room rate is check on arrival.

faqs.q: What does the Bach Ma ticket cost?
faqs.a: Check on arrival. The park table updated 1 May 2025 prints adult 65,000 VND, and child, pupil, student, and senior 25,000 VND. The 2021 feature and the Vietnam Airlines table dated 1 May 2024 print the same 65,000 and 25,000. VnExpress, updated 4 Feb 2025, prints adult 60,000 VND and reduced 20,000 VND. No separate viewpoint or waterfall ticket was on the trail pages.

faqs.q: Can a car reach the Bach Ma summit?
faqs.a: Check on arrival. From 1 Jan 2026 the park notice stops motor vehicles at the slip at km 12: about 500 m on foot across it, then about 7 km to Hải Vọng Đài. On 13 Jun 2026 the director said the slip was still unrepaired: about 600 m on a path around it, then a motorbike or more walking. The May 2025 shuttle table still prices a 16-seat, a 7-seat, and a 4-seat to the summit. Those rules are all in public at once.

faqs.q: How high is Hai Vong Dai?
faqs.a: The pages do not agree. Park trail pages: about 1,430 m. VnExpress handbook: about 1,430 m at the viewpoint, and a historical summit of 1,440 m. The 2021 feature: 1,450 m above the prayer bell. VnExpress, 7 Mar 2025: higher than 1,400 m.

faqs.q: How large is Bach Ma National Park?
faqs.a: Decision 214/CT of 15 Jul 1991 established it at 22,031 ha. For the 2008 expansion, the July 2025 park note prints 37,423.1 ha and the February 2012 note prints 37,487 ha, of which 34,380 ha in Thừa Thiên Huế and 3,107 ha in Quảng Nam. VnExpress prints more than 37,400 ha. Vietnam Airlines prints nearly 37,500 ha.

season.label: March to December, if the road is open
season.note: The 2021 feature calls March–December the drier window, as Huế travel advice, not as a park climate table. VnExpress says the summit mean is 19°C and the park mean is 25°C, and that one day can feel like four seasons. The flower report says about 20°C at Vọng Hải Đài. Báo Văn hóa, quoting the director in June 2026, says the rainfall is among the highest in the country and that the late October 2025 flood destroyed the roadbed at km 12. No millimetre figure was on the pages that loaded. White đỗ quyên was out in early March 2025. Red đỗ quyên is the spring flower on the rocks at thác Đỗ Quyên. The next bloom date was not printed. After heavy rain, confirm the road the day before.
